# WorldBox Modding Docs — full WBML AI guide

## Baseline
WorldBox 0.51.2 build 719; Unity 2022.3.60f1; NeoModLoader 1.2.0.1; Political World 1.7.0 / PoliticalWorldAPI 1.14.0 where applicable.

## Retrieval hierarchy
1. manifest.json
2. canonical raw atlas for the exact suite
3. Detailed Docs
4. Research methodology/boundaries
5. Quick Docs for concise human guidance

## Canonical machine files
0200-automatic-api-atlas.json — 0.2.0-fix3
0300-capability-verification-atlas.json — 0.3.0-fix1
0400-parameterized-query-atlas.json — 0.4.0-fix2
0500-safe-mutation-atlas.json — 0.5.0
0600-entity-lifecycle-atlas.json — 0.6.0-fix5
0700-persistence-identity-atlas.json — 0.7.0
0800-world-game-integration-atlas.json — 0.8.0-fix1
0900-coverage-closure-atlas.json — 0.9.0
1000-practical-modding-baseline.json — consolidation/freeze record, not a runtime suite

## High-value rules
- Reflection/public access and runtime success are separate dimensions.
- Parameterized query evidence is tied to exact argument provenance.
- OBSERVED-THREW is one argument-set result, not universal failure.
- VERIFIED-REVERSIBLE is exact-scope mutation evidence.
- Actor/Building may be replaced with the same logical ID after load; re-resolve.
- Building kill and empty Kingdom evidence in 0.6 is bounded-window evidence, not forever.
- Harmony ordering/owner observations are version-bound.
- Discovery of NML reload/listener types is not evidence that arbitrary live reload/instantiation is safe.
- The 0.9 family counts are closure census only; they are not safety classifications.
- WBML 1.0 FROZEN means the current practical research campaign is closed. It does not mean every one of 18,625 methods was invoked.

## Freeze trigger
Re-open broad WBML research only if WorldBox/NML changes or a direct contradiction to the frozen baseline is found. Otherwise use the baseline to debug/build the real mod.
